claims.quote: Gene sequencing revealed that they carried two novel compound heterozygous missense variants of the TBC1D24: c.116 C > T (p.Ala39Val) and c.827 T > C (p.Ile276Thr) in patient 1; c.404 C > T (p.Pro135Leu) and c.679 T > C (p.Arg227Trp) in patient 2.
They result in a rare phenotype, characterized by drug-resistant epilepsy and deafness.
Audiologic examination showed bilateral sensorineural hearing loss in both patients.
